comparison.objective: Crack an egg into a bowl and dispose of both shell halves; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually tap a fragile shell, pull halves apart, manage released contents, and sort shells, versus precision tool torque and collar tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Yolk and at least five white drops must reach the bowl, both shells the tray, with no shell in the bowl; candidate requires two safe, repeatable impact stops.
comparison.reason: Fragile-object fracture and contents control are materially unrelated to mechanical adjustment.
